title: Moulin Rouge!
about: A young writer falls for the star of a Paris nightclub promised to a jealous duke.
cue: Serve the drinks when the Green Fairy appears to the Bohemians.
faces: Welcome, darlings. Drinks first, tragedy later, and not a word during the show. The Duke is paying.
Fresh shucked oysters on ice with shallot vinegar and lemon.
Warm gruyère cheese puffs with a hint of nutmeg.
Elephant supper duck with cherry sauce
Crisp-skinned duck breast, red wine cherry sauce and buttery mashed potatoes.
The bohemians who come crashing through Christian's ceiling.
Sweet pastry shell with vanilla custard and fresh raspberries.
Green fairy absinthe or green apple mint
Absinthe dripped over a sugar cube, or green apple, mint and soda for everyone else.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing the giant elephant in the garden at the tables. Card No. 2001. Showtime: Serve the drinks when the Green Fairy appears to the Bohemians.

The Elephant RoomMoulin Rouge!Paris nightclub. Order the champagne.Every recipe serves 4.

    StartersMoulin Rouge oystersFresh shucked oysters on ice with shallot vinegar and lemonHow to make it2 shallots, finely diced80ml red wine vinegar1 tsp cracked black pepper24 oysters, freshly shucked6 cups crushed ice2 lemons, cut in wedgesMix the shallots, vinegar and pepper for the mignonette and rest.Shuck the oysters.Lay the oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette alongside.Montmartre gougèresWarm gruyère cheese puffs with a hint of nutmegHow to make it125ml water50g butter75g plain flour2 eggs80g gruyere, grated1 pinch of nutmegHeat the oven to 200°C and line a tray. Boil the water and butter, beat in the flour and stir over heat for a minute.Cool slightly, then beat in the eggs, gruyere and nutmeg.Pipe small rounds onto the tray.Bake until puffed and golden.MainsElephant supper duck with cherry sauceCrisp-skinned duck breast, red wine cherry sauce and buttery mashed potatoesHow to make it4 duck breasts200g cherries, pitted200ml red wine1 tsp fresh thyme1kg potatoes, peeled100g buttersalt and pepper, to tasteScore the duck skin, season with salt and pepper and render skin side down over medium heat.Roast at 200°C, then rest.Simmer the cherries with the wine and thyme until syrupy.Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter until silky.Slice the duck and serve with the cherry sauce.Toulouse's bohemian steak fritesThe bohemians who come crashing through Christian's ceilingHow to make itAs written, serves 4Dry-brined sirloin seared hard in cast iron, sliced over skinny double-fried frites, with café de Paris butter melting on top and a sharp watercress salad.Salt 4 sirloin steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.Mash 100g soft butter with 1 tsp Dijon, 1 chopped anchovy, 1 small garlic clove, chopped parsley, tarragon and capers, roll into a log and chill.Fry 1kg skinny cut potatoes at 140°C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 185°C for 3 minutes.Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side to 54°C, rest 5 minutes and slice.Top with butter coins and serve with frites and dressed watercress.SweetsRed windmill raspberry tartSweet pastry shell with vanilla custard and fresh raspberriesHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry400ml milk3 egg yolks80g caster sugar2 tbsp cornflour300g raspberries3 tbsp raspberry jamHeat the oven to 180°C. Line a tart tin with the pastry and blind bake.Cook the milk, yolks, sugar and cornflour until thick.Chill the custard and the case.Fill the case with custard.Cover with raspberries edge to edge and brush with warm jam.DrinksGreen fairy absinthe or green apple mintAbsinthe dripped over a sugar cube, or green apple, mint and soda for everyone elseHow to make it40ml absinthe, for the grown ups2 sugar cubes, for the grown ups3 green apples1 handful of mint400ml soda water2 cups iceFor the grown ups, drip cold water over a sugar cube into the absinthe until cloudy.For everyone else, blitz the apples with mint and strain.Pour the absinthe mix or the apple mint juice into small glasses over ice and top with soda water.
